model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each criterion from a list of six categories, with the categories labeled along the vertical axis and the number of participants along the horizontal axis, which is scaled linearly from 0 to 6. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, starting with “Relevant FCs” at the top. The “Relevant FCs” bar is dark purple and extends to a value of 6, indicating it was selected by all six participants. The “FC Summary” bar is dark blue and reaches a value of 5. The “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” bars are both teal and extend to a value of 3. The “Overall Summary” bar is green and reaches a value of 2. The “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” bars are both a lighter green and extend to a value of 1. All bars are solid-colored and unannotated, with no visual emphasis or grouping beyond their horizontal alignment.
